discovery: Development of next-generation (massively parallel sequencing-by-synthesis) DNA sequencing
rationale: Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis rests on reversible-terminator nucleotide chemistry and cluster amplification. It changed biology and medicine by making genome sequencing cheap and routine. Its inventors have already won major prizes that often come before a Nobel, including the Millennium Technology Prize (2020) and the Breakthrough Prize (2022). The chemistry committee has recently favored chemical tools with broad impact, and the field has not yet been honored.
